system.description:
When you activate a Force Power, you can spend a Force Point to corrupt the Force Power. The Force Power gains the [Dark Side] descriptor, and opponents who have a Dark Side Score lower than yours take a -2 penalty to all Defense Scores against this activation of the Force Power.

Alternatively, you can spend a Destiny Point to increase the penalty to opponents' Defense Scores to -5. You cannot use this Force Secret unless your Dark Side Score equals your Wisdom score.

Force Powers that have the [Light Side] descriptor cannot be corrupted by the use of this Force Secret.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
